items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: when we finished playing he said, wowee! ... Monk told me at one time we had the best spot in jazz band in town. ... Monk was a kick. But he sure could beat those drums.

ctx.x: Well, that was Henry was that guy, wasn't it? No, I remember.
It was Abbey Brunis, the drum player's brother. Yeah. I can't, we called him Monk. I remember him. We called him Monk. He had a big chin.
